stations.title: Rhiannon
stations.say: Can the laptop say what is free?

stations.title: Phone at the gate
stations.text: Opens an address, and nothing answers.

captions: At Marrowfield, Rhiannon is asked every evening whether a plot is free.
A visitor at the gate can open an address on a phone, but nothing on the laptop answers.
You write a server that answers every request with the free plots, in four tasks.
Now the phone asks the laptop, and plot A3 comes back as free.
Same question at the gate, no phone call. The laptop answers anyone who asks.
